name: Croquis
detailed_description:
A new day begins at the factory. The scientists’ voices crackle from the overhead speakers. They’ve put a pencil and a piece of paper in your hands.

Croquis opens with a simple task for you: draw the shape — the top-down view — of the constructions you come across.

Each room is a new puzzle: a structure you’ll need to explore, understand, and sketch without mistakes.

An immersive adventure

Step into the metal body of Unit 35 — a robot used by a team of scientists to train and improve their artificial intelligence project.

Wander through the series of rooms they’ve built for you to complete your task. That is, unless you manage to escape their little experiment…

A puzzle mechanic that evolves over time

At first, you were asked to draw top-down views of constructions. But who said a pencil and a piece of paper could only be used for that?

As you progress, the shape and the purpose of your sketches will start to shift. Use them to overcome tricky situations... or to break free from your owners.

short_description: Croquis is a first person, 3D puzzle & platformer game. You play as Unit 35, a robot used by scientists to draw the top-down view of buildings on paper, in order to train their AI for an unknown architectural project.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or Direct3D 12 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support or Direct3D 12 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
